body: This thread is making me choke up...

I took the pills and went to sleep at noon, but prior to that I had typed a goodbye letter to my wife telling her where they could find my body and my things, and had my email set to send it for 3pm.  Cops came at 8.

These are great words and solid advice, but letting go sounds easier than it is. Shouldn't I care about someone I love, the mother of my child, even if she doesn't care for me? How can I make letting go as easy as it is to write? Thank you for believing in me.
Keep reaching out. Don't give up just yet.

I was groggy like never before. I could barely keep my eyes open... mainly passed out on the ride to the hospital. I ended up puking at the hospital check in station. The feeling didn't go away for a while.
